gold_sql:
WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-123.160374 44.638732)',4326) AS pt
),
patch AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(pt::geography, 100)::geometry AS g FROM origin
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, p.g)) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d
  JOIN patch p ON ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.g)
),
aspect_rast AS (
  SELECT ST_Aspect(rast, 1, '32BF', 'DEGREES') AS rast
  FROM clipped_dem
)
SELECT ST_Value(a.rast, 1, o.pt) AS aspect_degrees
FROM aspect_rast a, origin o;

  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM parks
  WHERE id = 255954
),
aspect_raster AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Azimuth(
      ST_Transform(ST_Centroid(p.geom), 4326),
      ST_ValueLocation(
        r.rast,
        p.geom,
        1,
        'NEAREST'
      )::geometry
    ) * (180 / pi()) AS aspect_degrees
  FROM 
    park_geom p,
    LATERAL ST_Clip(public.dem_us.rast, p.geom, true) AS r(rast)
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(aspect_degrees) AS aspect_degrees
FROM 
  aspect_raster;
